ideas.title: Why you lost: a metrics debrief
ideas.pitch: The end screen turns PlayMetrics into a short timeline: when the bank ran dry, which weapons starved, when each raider tier unlocked, where the Node took damage. First slice: three auto-picked 'turning points' from the existing metrics JSON on the loss screen.
ideas.hook: 'Your snipers ran dry at 6:50, two minutes before the Brutes arrived' and you instantly know what to try next

history.why: Gregory 2026-10-14: enact all six via one Muse long run, Opus reviews

ideas.title: Paint targets for the network
ideas.pitch: The Operative carries a designator: painting a raider group, Spitter Tower or nest makes Snipers, mortars and the Lance prioritise it for 10 s. First slice: a designate action that sets a priority target read by WeaponLogic target selection.
ideas.hook: Calling a Bertha shell onto a tower you're crouched beside

history.why: Gregory 2026-10-14: enact all six via one Muse long run, Opus reviews

ideas.title: Flood the courtyard
ideas.pitch: Creeper already ignores gates, so a Terp channel can steer the tide into a hostile castle: wet raiders take damage and the crown nest's spawns drown. Turns the enemy's own weapon into a siege tool, with the risk that the flood comes back at you. First slice: creeper contact damages raiders (RAIDER_WET_DPS in config), then a smoke test that a channelled flood clears a courtyard.
ideas.hook: Breaking a dam and watching the creeper pour through the gatehouse

ideas.title: Pressure bounties
ideas.pitch: Mid-level, timed side objectives appear (kill nest X in 3 min, hold a ridge for 60 s); success pays Aether and knocks the pressure curve back, failure pulls the next raider tier forward. Punishes turtling with choices, not just bigger numbers. First slice: one bounty type driven from the level's RAID_SCHEDULE data.
ideas.hook: Gambling your Operative on a 90-second dash to buy the base another minute

history.why: Gregory 2026-10-14: enact all six via one Muse long run, Opus reviews

ideas.title: Survey charges for hidden ore
ideas.pitch: Ore veins beyond network reach are hidden until the Operative plants a survey charge on foot; found veins become Outpost sites, so exploring on foot shapes where the network expands. First slice: hidden flag on level ore rows plus a survey interactable that reveals one vein.
ideas.hook: Finding a rich vein behind a castle and deciding whether it's worth a second front

history.why: Gregory 2026-10-14: enact all six via one Muse long run, Opus reviews

ideas.title: Last-stand overdrive
ideas.pitch: Once per level, when the Node falls below 25% HP, the player can overclock: every weapon fires twice as fast for 20 s, then the network stalls for 30 s. A real comeback decision with a sharp cost. First slice: an Overdrive action with OVERDRIVE_* tunables multiplying WeaponLogic.fire_interval.
ideas.hook: Hitting overdrive with the creeper at the Node's feet and pushing it back

history.why: Gregory 2026-10-14: enact all six via one Muse long run, Opus reviews

ideas.title: Every shot starves them
ideas.pitch: Humanoid harvesters pump creeper into their stockpile; reinforcement rate and ammo scale with what they've banked. Killing creeper near their pumps is economic warfare, and leaving it alone feeds them. First slice: one harvester rig per nest site whose bank, read from creeper depth in its radius, speeds that site's spawns.
ideas.hook: Watching a raid thin out because you shelled their harvest field dry

ideas.title: Cut their creeper pipeline
ideas.pitch: Enemies lay pipelines and canals from emitters to their bases. The Operative blows a pipe with a demo charge, or Terp cuts a canal, and the flow diverts: their base starves, but the spill lands somewhere, maybe on you. First slice: a pipeline as a chain of enemy structures that moves creeper from an emitter cell to a base cell; breaking one link spills at the break.
ideas.hook: Blowing a pipe and seeing a creeper river swing away from their keep

ideas.title: Creeper-dosed shock troops
ideas.pitch: Before a big push, humanoids dose on creeper: they glow, move faster, hit harder, and spill creeper where they die. Where you fight them becomes a decision, because killing them inside your base floods it. First slice: a dosed flag on a raid group (speed/dps multipliers) plus a death spill via CreeperSim.add.
ideas.hook: Holding fire until the glowing squad crosses the ridge so they spill on their side

ideas.title: Sabotage the deep harvest
ideas.pitch: Enemies also mine creeper at the cave's Deep Core, and that harvest feeds the pressure curve. A cave incursion that wrecks their deep rigs knocks pressure back, so going underground buys time for the surface. First slice: deep rigs as cave targets; each one destroyed applies a Pressure relief (shares I-004's offset).
ideas.hook: Coming back up from the cave to a quieter surface because you broke their supply
